subject.title: State publishers thrash under concurrent writes

question: Does this issue describe a remaining publisher-contention bug beyond the exact-review publication starvation already covered by https://github.com/openclaw/clawsweeper/issues/606, and if so, which publisher paths and expected behavior are in scope?
rationale: The title is broader than the concrete related report, and the empty body does not establish a reproducible remaining defect or a safe implementation boundary.

options.title: Request a bounded reproduction
options.body: Ask for the contending publisher paths, an observable failure, and current-main evidence before opening a new repair path.

options.title: Treat it as the resolved narrow case
options.body: If the intended report was only the exact-publication starvation scenario, close it as covered by the resolved related work.

recommendation.title: Request a bounded reproduction
recommendation.body: Ask for the contending publisher paths, an observable failure, and current-main evidence before opening a new repair path.

likelyOwner.reason: The member-authored report needs the reporter's intended operational scope and expected behavior before maintainer triage can safely narrow it.
